# SEO Geo

A specialised sub-skill of the claude-seo family (orchestrated by the seo skill, a separate listing): it audits a site for AI search visibility (AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Bing Copilot) across citability, structure, brand signals and AI crawler access, framing GEO as SEO fundamentals per Google's own guide. At use it fetches the target site's pages and robots.txt over the network and writes a GEO-ANALYSIS.md report; optional DataForSEO MCP visibility checks when available. Its text states fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions, and contains no 'Built by agricidaniel' footer instruction.
